framework.description: IT-RULES: IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, Part II. ECOM-RULES: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

clause.description: References in this finding's framework, separated by commas, e.g. 'Rule 3(2)(a)(i), Rule 4(1)(c)'. Validation rejects a reference that is not a clause in catalog/rules.json, or a sub-clause of one.

cross_reference.description: Any other instrument the gap touches, e.g. 'DPDP s.8(7): see Vigil'. Free text; nothing validates it.

file.description: Source file path relative to the audited codebase's root. Never absolute. Leave it out for a missing artefact.

url.description: Public page the finding was seen on, for live-site checks. No query string or fragment.
